description: This file implements modulation mapping functions for various modulation schemes, including lookup tables for QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, 256-QAM, BPSK, and π/2-BPSK, with optimized encoding for specific modulation orders.

classes.name: modulator_table_s
classes.description: Template class providing lookup tables and modulation functions for modulation orders greater than 2 with even values.

classes.name: modulator_table_bpsk
classes.description: Class providing lookup tables and modulation functions for BPSK modulation.

classes.name: modulator_table_pi_2_bpsk
classes.description: Class providing lookup tables and modulation functions for π/2-BPSK modulation.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Performs modulation of input bits into complex symbols or scaled 8-bit symbols based on the modulation scheme.

methods.name: get_modulation_scaling
methods.description: Returns the scaling factor associated with a given modulation scheme.
